subject: maths
question:
A company produced a new energy drink of three different flavours - P, Q and R - for athletes. The production of the three flavours over a period of six years from 2001 to 2006 has been expressed in the bar graph shown below. Study the graph and answer the question that follows. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ead1e581f98e2b1e133f5c3e87e87bcca30b1f5ae276eaaa9ff40d08bb543e88.png] 

What is the difference between the average production of bottles of flavour Q in 2004, 2005 and 2006 and the average production of flavour P in 2001, 2002 and 2003?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The production of bottles of flavour Q in 2004, 2005 and 2006 = (550 + 500 + 550) 

⇒ 1600 lakh

The average production of bottles of flavour Q in 2004, 2005 and 2006 = (1600/3) lakh

⇒ 533.33 lakh

The production of bottles of flavour P in 2001, 2002 and 2003 = (500 + 400 + 550) 

⇒ 1450 lakh

The average production of bottles of flavour P in 2001, 2002 and 2003 = (1450/3)

⇒ 483.33 lakh

The difference between the average production of bottles of flavour Q in 2004, 2005 and 2006 and the average production of flavour P in 2001, 2002 and 2003

⇒ Rs. (533.33 – 483.33) lakh

⇒ Rs. 50 lakh

**∴ The required difference is Rs. 50,00,000**
